artworks.title: Saint Paul
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated reading an open book. He has a large forehead, thinning hair on top, fuller, curly hair on the sides and back, a full beard, and a focused expression. He wears a loose robe and a sword at his side. His hands are engaged with the book, one resting on the page and the other supporting it. The background is a simple design with linear shading, resembling a wall or tapestry in a dimly lit setting. The bottom of the image contains text labeling the subject as "S. PAVLVS."

artworks.title: Pool in a Formal Garden
artworks.description: The image shows a tranquil scene with clusters of trees lining the horizon. A sculpted figure sits on a pedestal on the right side, partially hidden by tall grasses. The brushstrokes are fine and intricate, emphasizing the detailing of foliage and water texture. The color palette is warm sepia tones. In the distance, there are faint clouds, a few birds in the sky, and a far tree line for added depth.

artworks.title: Diana Recumbent
artworks.description: The image depicts a full-body view of a reclining person with closed eyes. They have short, wavy hair and one arm resting on their forehead while the other lies alongside their body. The person appears to be nude and is lying on a piece of fabric. A sleeping dog is positioned beside them. In the background, detailed illustrations of trees and foliage create a dense natural setting. Smaller figures or animals are seen in the distance among the trees, adding depth to the scene.

artworks.title: A Rocky Pond
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 10.2 x 15.6 cm (4 x 6 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a landscape view with a natural scene depicted in fine etching. The horizon is situated towards the middle of the composition, where the land gently rises, and a subtle outline of distant hills is visible. Large rocks and foliage are depicted close to us, with a lone, barren tree extending upwards on the left side. The etching features intricate and well-defined brushstrokes, including thin lines and cross-hatching to create texture and depth. The color palette is monochromatic, with dark tones against a lighter background. In the distance, additional clusters of trees can be seen, rendered with similar linework to convey movement and detail.

artworks.title: A Rocky Pond
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees, rocks, and water. The perspective is slightly elevated. Rocks are prominent in the central area, with various shapes and textures. Trees and foliage are depicted with detailed brushstrokes. The color scheme is sepia, creating a warm and vintage atmosphere. The scene includes water reflecting rocks, distant hills, and faint cloud formations.

artworks.title: Mountainous Landscape
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 10.2 x 16 cm (4 x 6 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape scene with a detailed tree on the left side. A rocky formation, shrubs, and grasses are near the tree, with a calm body of water further beyond. In the background, there is a hill or mountain range with peaks rising gently to the right. The color palette is monochromatic, predominantly brown and cream, emphasizing the textures and lines defining the elements of nature.

artworks.title: Querulas praetentat pollice cordas (The Lute Player)
artworks.artist: Johann Bernard after Orazio Gentileschi (formerly Caravaggio)
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body view of a seated person turned slightly toward the viewer. She is positioned leaning forward with her right elbow resting on a table and her left hand holding the neck of a lute above her head. Her facial features are gentle, with a soft profile. She has light hair styled in loose curls and intricately braided at the back. She is wearing a white, long-sleeved blouse with puffed sleeves beneath a sleeveless dress and a flowing skirt. The skirt and dress are richly detailed with folds and textures. In front of her on the table is an open book and a violin partially visible, along with a few other indistinct objects. The background is dark and plain.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Apollo
artworks.medium: black chalk and black, white, and gray gouache on tan wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing portraying a mythological scene. The detailed composition includes classical elements and mythological figures. Cherubic figures and angelic beings are depicted at the top around a radiant sun. Below them, draped figures gather amidst clouds and greenery. Flowing ribbons create movement throughout the image. The foreground shows figures in classical attire engaged in a celebratory or ritualistic scene, surrounded by ornate trees. There is a balance between the heavenly realm above and the elaborate gathering below, capturing a moment from a mythological narrative.

artworks.title: Harlequin and Scaramouche Create a "Fountain"
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and gray wash on laid paper, scored for transfer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of five figures engaged in a comedic performance. The scene depicts the figures in elaborate costumes and exaggerated stances. Each figure holds various props, set against a detailed garden background with fountains and structures. The drawing captures a moment of lively interaction, emphasizing expressions and gestures indicative of a playful narrative.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child Surrounded by Saints and Angels
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink heightened with white lead over metalpoint underdrawing on prepared pink paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 22.3 x 15.3 cm (8 3/4 x 6 in.)
framed: 45.7 x 38.1 cm (18 x 15 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of figures in a religious setting. The central figure is a seated woman holding a child who reaches out to another figure. The seated woman, likely the Virgin Mary, appears with subtle facial features and draped garments. The child she holds, likely Jesus, extends towards another child, possibly John the Baptist, held by a kneeling woman on the right side. Other figures in the scene include a kneeling man and at least two angelic figures above them, one of whom crowns the central figure. Additionally, there is a notable kneeling figure at the top left. Background elements include faint decorative designs.

artworks.title: A Kneeling Angel
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink heightened with white over metalpoint on gray-blue prepared paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the lower portion of a person's figure, primarily from the waist down to the knees, in a kneeling position. The figure is positioned slightly towards the right side of the image. The person's facial features are not distinctly detailed. The figure appears to have long hair and is wearing a flowing garment, possibly a robe or dress. There is a circular form near the figure. The background is a lightly textured, pale surface with variations in shade, but there are no distinguishable features or objects.

artworks.title: An Elderly Jew and a Muslim Tartar in the Crimea
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows two men depicted in different views. The first man is seated, wearing a blue robe and dark headdress, with a long, gray beard. He holds a fabric or scroll. The second man is shown standing and in portrait, wearing a long robe and white headdress. He has a shorter beard and serious expression, and is barefoot in the standing view. The central portrait focuses on his detailed face. The image also includes a detailed sketch of a hand with a ring. The background is plain.

artworks.title: La Mort sur un champ de bataille [Death on a Battlefield]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut to platemark): 21.1 x 29 cm (8 5/16 x 11 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a skeletal figure riding a horse amidst a chaotic scene. The drawing features a skeleton draped in a tattered cloak, mounted on a spirited horse at the center. The surroundings show various figures and horses in the background, some in turmoil or combat. Text in delicate script is present in the lower part of the image, possibly providing context or an inscription in French. The drawing captures a scene of chaos and death, likely evoking themes of mortality and the futility of war.

artworks.title: Chateau of Vallambrosa, Cannes
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Charles Isaacs and Carol Nigro in memory of Diamon Gangji
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a castle-like structure on a hill. The horizon is high, with a dark sky meeting a lighter landscape. The castle stands prominently on the horizon, with towers and fortified walls. The brushstrokes are fine and detailed, depicting architecture and terrain textures. The color palette is a contrast of dark browns and lighter tones, emphasizing shadows and highlights. Closest to us are barren trees and sloped terrain leading up to the castle. In the distance, beyond the trees, the terrain rises, with the castle and smaller buildings dispersed along the hill.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate scroll held by two armored figures. The image features two figures on either side, dressed in classical armor and adorned with decorative plumes on their helmets. They hold up a large draped fabric with text inscribed on it, which appears to be in French. Above the fabric, there is a heraldic crest featuring a shield with a lion, and elaborate scrollwork surrounding a helmet topped with a lion holding a sword. The figures are positioned to showcase both the ornamental details of their attire and the floral and ribbon decorations embellishing the fabric. The overall composition is symmetrical, emphasizing the majesty and formality of the heraldic display.

artworks.title: The Fight for the Standard
artworks.artist: Gerard Edelinck after Sir Peter Paul Rubens after Leonardo da Vinci
artworks.dimensions: sheet (cut within platemark): 45 x 60.6 cm (17 11/16 x 23 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This print features a battle scene with horses and armed soldiers. Multiple horses are rearing up against each other, with armored warriors engaged in combat on their backs. We see the twisting limbs and heads of the horses and warriors all together in a jumble, making it difficult to see exactly how many there are. Soldiers swing their weapons at each other or grab each other's limbs, their faces contorted and mouths open. More people are seen on the ground below the horses, grappling with each other, some with large round shields. The sky behind the scene and the ground below are filled with thin, swirling, crosshatching lines.

artworks.title: The Drawing Academy in Amsterdam
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in a drawing class set in the 18th century. The participants, primarily men, are seated on benches observing and sketching a nude statue at the center of the room. They are dressed in period attire, including long coats, waistcoats, and tricorn hats. The room is dimly lit by an overhead lamp, illuminating the statue and participants. The walls are decorated with framed drawings or sketches, and there is no modern technology present in the scene.

artworks.title: Architectural Details for a Wall Decoration with Empress Maria Theresia Embracing the Young Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on ivory paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural sketch featuring decorative elements and structures. The drawing illustrates a section of a building interior or facade with ornate architectural details, such as archways and column capitals. In the middle of the composition, there is a figure of a woman sitting on an elaborate chair. The drawing is executed in a loose, sketchy style, with detailed line work. The use of curves and scrolls in the embellishments adds to the intricate design.

artworks.title: Altenhausen bei Freysing
artworks.medium: black and chalk with white heightening and gray wash on blue paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape of dense vegetation viewed from a slightly elevated point. There is a forested area with trees dominating the scene. Soft hills are visible in the distance, merging with the sky. The painting is detailed, with precise brushstrokes depicting the trees. The color palette is deep blue, possibly suggesting twilight or moonlight. The sky has light clouds, enhancing the atmospheric depth of the scene.

artworks.title: An Ancient Tree Fallen Beside a Stream
artworks.medium: pen and black and gray ink over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: The image shows a sprawling, twisted tree trunk dominating the scene. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, and the horizon is low. The tree trunk lies horizontally across the image with intricate linework. The style is detailed and precise, using an etching technique with hatchings and cross-hatchings. The image is monochromatic with black and white tones emphasizing shadows and highlights. In the distance, faint outlines of trees and a partially obscured structure can be seen.

artworks.title: The Fortune Teller
artworks.artist: Attributed to Andries Jacobsz Stock after Jacques de Gheyn II
artworks.description: The image shows three people standing outdoors. The central figure is a woman in a flowing dress with detailed ruffles. To her left is a person wearing a dress and hat with a veil. To her right is an older person in a robe and head covering. A fourth figure is partially visible behind the older person. The ground has a sculptural face and foliage, and there is a large tree in the background.

artworks.title: Caffè Florian in Venice
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ernest Hillman, Jr., in memory of his friend, John Davis Skilton, Jr.
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene with a square filled with people and pigeons. A large building with multiple arches dominates the middle section of the painting. The brushstrokes are loose and fluid, typical of a watercolor technique. The color palette includes earthy tones with hints of blue, green, and red. Various clothing colors on the figures add interest to the composition, and street lamps are shown on the street.

artworks.title: Momies Egyptiennes (Egyptian Mummies)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Joyce and Robert B. Menschel
artworks.description: Two wrapped mummies stand propped against a rough, earthen wall in this vertical black and white photograph. The mummy on our left is entirely covered with light-colored fabric while the mummy on the right appears to be uncovered or the coverings have melded to the skin and skeleton. A dark-skinned man sits against the wall to the left of the mummies. He wears a cap and a long, loose, light-colored tunic. His bare feet are planted on the dry, cracked dirt ground, his knees bent so he can prop one elbow on a knee to rest his head, sleeping. His arms and head are slightly blurred, and a vessel sits between his feet. Another mummy, wrapped more thickly than the other two, lies across the bottom of the picture. A larger painted vessel with a wide belly and artifacts, including perhaps a wrapped skull and an oil lamp, are displayed around the prone mummy. Cursive text along the bottom of the photograph reads "235 Momies Egyptiennes."

artworks.title: Hector of Troy, Alexander the Great and Julius Caesar
artworks.artist: Primary Master of the Strassburg Chronicle
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over traces of black chalk on on laid paper ruled in leadpoint
artworks.description: The image shows three armored figures standing in a frontal position. The figure on the left wears ornate armor with a feathered plume on their helmet. The middle figure has a beard and mustache, wearing a crown over the helmet, with detailed armor. The figure on the right also has facial hair and a helmet with decorative plumes. Each figure holds a sword in their right hand and shields with heraldic symbols rest on the ground. The background features a tiled floor with a geometric pattern and medieval-style text inscribed above and below the figures.
